transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you for calling Cymbal Telecom. My name is Sarah. How can I help you today?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Hi Sarah. I'm an existing internet customer and I was hoping to get some information about getting a mobile hotspot.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I can certainly help with that. To access your account and check for any loyalty offers, I'll just need to verify your information. Could I please get your full name and Customer ID?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sure. My name is James Gonzalez, and my customer ID is CUST-1032.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Thank you, Mr. Gonzalez. And for security, could you please provide the four-digit PIN on your account?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect, thank you. I've got your account pulled up here. So, you're interested in a mobile hotspot. Can you tell me a little more about what you're looking for?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yeah, I do a bit of recreational travel and the Wi-Fi in hotels and RV parks can be pretty unreliable. I need something I can use on the road for my laptop. I probably need a decent amount of data, maybe around 50 gigabytes a month.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That makes perfect sense. We have an excellent device called the Cymbal Go Hotspot, and we offer a few different data plans. Based on your needs, our 'Explorer 50GB' plan sounds like it would be a perfect fit.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, the Explorer 50GB plan. How much does that run per month?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Explorer 50GB plan is just $40 per month. It gives you 50 gigabytes of high-speed data on our 5G network.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That sounds reasonable. And what about the hotspot device itself? Is there a cost for that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: The Cymbal Go Hotspot normally retails for $99. However, since you're already a valued Cymbal Telecom Fiber customer, it looks like you're eligible for a loyalty discount. We can offer you the device for just $49.99.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, really? A discount is always nice. So it would be a one-time charge of $49.99 for the device, and then $40 a month for the service?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: That's exactly right. The one-time charge for the device plus applicable taxes, and then the monthly recurring charge for the data plan.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, that works for me. That sounds like a great deal. Let's go ahead and do that.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Excellent! I can place that order for you right now. Just to confirm, we are ordering the Cymbal Go Hotspot device...

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the one.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: ...and we are adding the Explorer 50GB mobile data plan to your account.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: That is correct.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Perfect. For the shipping address, I have on file 123 Main Street, Anytown, USA, 12345. Is that still the correct address to send the device?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Yes, that's the right address.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Great. The one-time charge for the device will be $49.99 plus tax. Would you like to pay for that today with a credit card, or would you prefer we simply add it to your next Cymbal Telecom bill?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Oh, can you just add it to my next bill with my internet service? That would be much easier.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Absolutely. We can certainly do that for you. So you'll see that one-time charge on your next statement, and the $40 monthly charge for the plan will begin with that billing cycle as well.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Sounds perfect. Thank you.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Okay, Mr. Gonzalez. I am submitting the order for you now... It will just take me about 30 seconds to finalize everything in the system. Please hold on the line.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: No problem, take your time.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright, thank you for your patience. The order has been successfully placed. Your order confirmation number is DH45887. You can expect the device to arrive in 3 to 5 business days.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: DH45887. Got it. And is it complicated to set up once I get it?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Not at all, it's very user-friendly. It comes with a quick start guide. You just need to power it on, and it will automatically connect to the Cymbal network. The Wi-Fi network name and password will be printed on a sticker on the back of the device.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Great. And the Wi-Fi network name, will it show up as 'Cymbal Wi-Fi' or something like that?

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Exactly. It will appear in your list of available networks as 'Cymbal Go' followed by a few unique numbers. The password will be right there on the sticker for you.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Excellent. This is just what I needed for my upcoming trip. This is a big help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: I'm so glad we could get that all sorted out for you today. You should also receive an email confirmation with all the order details and tracking information within the next hour.

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Okay, I'll keep an eye out for that. Thanks again for all your help.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: You are very welcome. Was there anything else I could assist you with today, Mr. Gonzalez?

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: Nope, that's everything for me.

transcript.speaker: Agent
transcript.text: Alright then. Thank you for choosing Cymbal Telecom and for being a loyal customer. We appreciate your business. Have a wonderful day!

transcript.speaker: User
transcript.text: You too. Goodbye.
